name: @treetopdevs/lattice-client
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript Lattice realm: op-DAG store, CRDT reduction (conformant to Lattice.Sim), and carrier sync. Consumed by the Tauri (Vue) and Expo (React Native) shells.
comment:tier-b-deps: The lattice-cbor-v1 carrier-frame codec is dependency-free; shells may add @noble/ed25519 or native key custody for signer/verifier implementations.
